source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check the status of  LED.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: human at the machine (visual LED check)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Visual inspection of solid-yellow InfiniBand physical-up LED.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly preserves physical solid-yellow visual acceptance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds GUID/port identity, fabric condition, ibstat support, traffic safety and explicit capture.
historical_reviews.round_02: NO; recognizes the physical observation boundary.

original_test_intent: Visually confirm that the exact Mellanox InfiniBand physical port displays a steady yellow indicator while that same port is in the approved Physical Up condition.
original_method: Map HCA GUID/port to the chassis connector, establish the approved InfiniBand link or fabric state, have an engineer directly observe the steady yellow LED, and correlate it with complete read-only port/fabric telemetry and logs.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer must visually distinguish yellow from other colors and steady illumination from blinking on the physical connector. `ibstat` can establish supporting state but cannot perform that acceptance observation.
required_inputs: HCA PCI identity, node/port GUID and physical connector label map
Project LED table for InfiniBand mode
Definition of Physical Up and approved fabric/link partner
Photo/video method, observation duration and maintenance window
OOB access and expected port/fabric state
safety_requirements: Confirm the exact port and approved fabric before any cable or partner-state change.
Do not infer LED color or steadiness from ibstat, counters or link state.
Avoid disturbing production fabric membership or traffic; stop on wrong GUID/port or fabric impact.
Preserve visual evidence and complete telemetry/logs without automatic link resets or retry.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare stable GUID/port/connector correlation and collect read-only HCA, port, fabric and log baseline.
Timestamp the approved Physical Up state and organize the engineer's visual evidence.
Collect final ibstat/fabric/error telemetry and compare recorded facts without claiming the observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the port, physical-up condition, partner/fabric state and observation method.
Directly observe and record the solid-yellow indicator.
Decide PASS/FAIL from visual and supporting evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects software execution of the visual core; no source command is provided.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use full read-only ibstat/fabric queries only to bind the manual observation to the correct GUID and Physical Up state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Solid yellow at InfiniBand Physical Up and both 3-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL VISUAL ACCEPTANCE WITH FABRIC CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record connector label and timestamped image/video together with full HCA GUID/port, PhysicalState/State and fabric evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact Mellanox adapter in InfiniBand mode and its project chassis/LED design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record adapter firmware, OFED/rdma-core, OS and link-partner/fabric versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project adapter/chassis LED specification and approved InfiniBand topology; generic public color conventions are not substituted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable physical/logical identity and fabric evidence while retaining manual color/steadiness verification.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED matrix and Physical Up topology.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera white balance and exposure can distort yellow; the responsible engineer validates the actual observation.

project_override_considerations: The project may define fabric partner, port scope and evidence duration but cannot replace the source's physical solid-yellow observation with software-only state.
expected_evidence: GUID/port/BDF-to-connector mapping and project LED table
Approved partner/fabric state and complete ibstat or equivalent Physical Up evidence
Engineer photo/video showing steady yellow on the mapped port
OS/BMC/fabric error evidence and final state
Separate Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently request a physical LED observation for InfiniBand Physical Up; omitted topology and port identity are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The required observation is clear and can be performed when project hardware/topology and an onsite engineer are available.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and the solid-yellow criterion.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains stable GUID/port mapping, fabric safety, telemetry and visual evidence requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Clarifies that Physical Up telemetry is corroboration, never a substitute for the specified color/steadiness observation.

review_improvement: Prevents evidence from the wrong HCA port or a software-only link state from being accepted as the physical LED result.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance fact is an optical property of a physical indicator. Machine-readable InfiniBand state can support correlation but cannot truthfully establish solid yellow, so MANUAL ONLY is required.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not cycle the port, cable or fabric state automatically after an unclear visual result; retain evidence and ask the engineer.
